method.transport: server-local loopback HTTP; no CPU or network throttling
method.motion: no-preference; configured exit400ms/gap200ms/entry400ms; actual phase completion observed
method.structure: CCO entered via public input; proxy is SDK struct().atoms.size === 3 plus sized SVG, not pixel or atom/bond identity verification
method.ready: native shared workspace ready plus 3 atoms and sized SVG; legacy has no equivalent host status so uses 3 atoms and sized SVG
method.cache: fresh browser context per environment; initial load and CCO entry excluded; normal HTTP caching enabled; no route interception
method.samples: 10 canvas owner transitions across six pages, then workbench/knowledge retention roundtrip
limitations: Server-local controlled sample, not measurements on the user workstation or WAN.
Same browser/instrumentation but environment, SDK and source versions differ between live9000 and9001.
Runs are sequential, not randomized; ordinary machine load and browser sampling affect exact timings.
Native host-ready does not assert that every asynchronous chemistry API has already completed.
Counterfactual modifies only a disposable browser closest query; product source and deployment unchanged.
Counterfactual moves main-thread initialization into animation; actual animation time and long tasks must also be considered.
Legacy hook isEditorReady/buttons are not measured; navigationAndContentReadyMs is an observed model/status proxy, not a fully equivalent interactivity guarantee across engines.
